title: Stress Less: 9 Habits from the Bible and Brain Science to Build Resilience and Reduce Anxi
description: We’re living in a stressed-out world. According to a poll from the American Psychological Association more than a quarter of U.S. adults say they’re so stressed they can’t function. But it’s not just adults. Teenagers and children are also experiencing the negative effects of stress. Blending brain science, biblical truth, and best practices, Stress Less provides hope and healing. From his PhD research, pastor Charles Stone presents nine actionable insights for those battling stress or who have friends or family with fear and anxiety. Stone writes about biblical characters who successfully and unsuccessfully navigated stress and shares how he’s responded to the stresses in his life, including a cancer diagnoses, heart issue, pre-diabetes diagnosis, and depression. Stone answers the questions: What is stress? What does stress do to the body and brain? How do we build resistance to stress? He shows how changes in thinking, feeling, sleep, spiritual practices, and relationships can help us thrive through life’s stresses. Readers learn how gratitude and soaking your soul in Jesus can cultivate a life of greater well-being and joy. While we can’t eliminate the stressors of life, we can learn to navigate them with courage and grace. title: Stress Less, Accomplish More: Meditation for Extraordinary Performance
description: A National Bestseller Foreword by Mark Hyman, MD Preface by Andrew Huberman, PhD You know you should be meditating, so what’s stopping you? This entertaining and enlightening book by the founder of Ziva Meditation—the favorite training for high achievers—will finally take meditation mainstream. In our high-stress, overworked lives, we think the answer to accomplishing more is to do more. But the best advantage we can give ourselves is to take a mental break—to spend a few minutes of the day giving the body and brain rest. Did you know that a brief meditation can offer rest that’s five times deeper than sleep? When you make time to practice the Z Technique this book teaches, you’ll actually be more productive than if you took an hour-and-a-half nap or had a cup of coffee. A leading expert in meditation for high performance, Emily Fletcher has taught meditation at numerous global corporations, including Google, Barclays Bank, and Viacom, to help their employees improve their focus and increase their productivity levels. With Stress Less, Accomplish More , anyone can get the benefits of her 15-minute twice-daily plan. Emily specifically developed the Z Technique for working people with busy lives. Now, you can learn to recharge anywhere, anytime—at home or at your desk. All you need is a few minutes and a chair (no apps, incense, or finger cymbals required). This is not just another meditation book. In Stress Less, Accomplish More , Emily teaches a powerful trifecta of Mindfulness, Meditation, and Manifesting to improve your personal and professional performance, clarity, health, and sleep. title: Gentle: Rest More, Stress Less, and Live the Life You Actually Want
description: From an expert on simplicity and minimalism, a collection of 30 practices to overcome chronic overwhelm, cultivate self-compassion, and find permission to do less–perfect for readers of Rest is Resistance and Wintering . Organized into three parts—Rest, Less, and Rise—Courtney Carver's Gentle provides simple challenges and practices that will help readers radically and gently shift their pace, headspace, and heart. Becoming the Gentle You is a practice of real self-care that, over time, will soothe your nervous system and strengthen your relationships. The Stress Less Devotional invites you to accept Jesus' offer with this 100-day journey to reconnect with the Lord and rejuvenate your soul. Block out the noise and get back to who you were made to be. Inside you will find: 100 devotions to encourage slow living and biblical rest Bible verses that restore you and point you to who God created you to be Daily prayers to help you quiet your thoughts and direct your attention on what really matters Calming beach photography to still your mind and remind you that God is in control A helpful Scripture index to guide deeper Bible reading It is time to worry less and start living more. title: Stress Less: A Teen's Guide to a Calm Chill Life
cats: Teen & Young Adult Emotions & Feelings Nonfiction eBooks
description: Let’s get real. Stress is part of every teen’s life -- stress of exams, college applications, a big game, difficult teachers, difficult friends, parents who don’t always get you, not to mention the dating and social scenes. Stress like this tends to build over time—week after week—and takes a toll on your mental health. But, great news! Learning stress-busting skills doesn’t take much time at all. Just 20 minutes a day is probably all it takes. The skills in this book are easy to learn and can be practiced anywhere -- on the bus, before bed, or during lunch. Once you see that it helps, you’ll adjust and be ready bust more stress. And then before you realize it—you’ve got it! Written by cognitive-behavioral therapist and stress-busting expert, Michael A. Tompkins, PhD, this book teaches concrete skills for managing stress and anxiety, organized into “stress domains” such as family, friends, dating, school, and tech/media. title: STRESS-LESS: A Guide to Managing Daily Stressors
description: STRESS-LESS: A Guide to Managing Daily Stressors Do you feel overwhelmed by daily stressors? Do you struggle to relax or find time for yourself? "STRESS-LESS: A Guide to Managing Daily Stressors" is here to help. In this practical and easy-to-read guide, you'll learn how to identify the sources of your stress and develop effective strategies to manage it. From simple relaxation techniques to time-management strategies, this book provides a comprehensive approach to managing stress in your daily life. Written by a certified stress-management coach, "STRESS-LESS" draws on the latest research in psychology and neuroscience to help you understand how stress affects your body and mind. You'll learn how to create a personalized stress-management plan that fits your lifestyle and needs, so you can feel more relaxed, focused, and energized every day. Whether you're a busy professional, a student, a parent, or anyone who wants to feel less stressed and more in control, "STRESS-LESS" is the ultimate guide to managing daily stressors. With practical advice and inspiring stories from real people who have successfully managed stress in their lives, this book will help you find balance, peace, and happiness in a stressful world. This is why you need to read this book. title: Stress Less Live More: A 100+ Living Guide to Beating Stress and Thriving (The 100+Living
description: In Stress Less, Live More, Dr. Graham Jenkins offers a powerful, evidence-based guide to beating stress and thriving in today’s fast-paced world. As the sixth book in the popular 100+Living Series, this guide combines Dr. Jenkins’ three decades of experience with the latest scientific research on stress management, mental resilience, and physical well-being. Whether you're a busy professional, a student, or anyone juggling the demands of modern life, this book provides actionable strategies for transforming your relationship with stress. Inside, you'll discover how to build resilience through physical health, mental discipline, and emotional regulation, using simple yet powerful techniques that have helped thousands of patients thrive. From incorporating Chiropractic BioPhysics (CBP) care to mastering mindfulness, sleep, and nutrition, Dr. Jenkins presents a holistic approach that will equip you to face life’s challenges with confidence and ease. Dr. Jenkins’ personal journey with stress is woven throughout the book, offering readers a candid and relatable narrative about the ups and downs of navigating life’s pressures. His practical advice, grounded in science and honed by years of working with families, makes this guide essential reading for anyone looking to not just manage stress, but thrive through it. If you're ready to take control of your stress, improve your well-being, and start living with purpose, Stress Less, Live More is the roadmap you need. Verified Amazon Review "Dr. Jenkins has a gift for translating complex health strategies into simple, actionable steps anyone can follow."
